The bidder must furnish a work completion and performance certificate for the similar nature of work, issued by a competent authority.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: RENOVATION AND MODERNIZATION OF HVAC SYSTEM INCLUDING COMPLETE DISMANTLING OF EXISTING SYSTEM, DESIGN, ENGINEERING, SUPPLY, ERECTION, TESTING, COMMISSIONING AND HANDING OVER OF ECO-FRIENDLY 28 TR FOR 220KV AND 42 TR FOR 400KV DX TYPE AC SYSTEM FOR RTPS ODY CONTROL ROOM ON TURN KEY BASIS AND BUYBACK OF EXISTING AC SYSTEM AT RTPS, SHAKTHI NAGAR.

itemList.description: Supply of 28 TR and 42 TR air-cooled DX condensing units suitable for R-407C refrigerant, compatible double-skin PUF-insulated AHUs of 11,200 CFM and 16,800 CFM capacities, refrigerant copper piping with insulation, R-407C refrigerant gas and oil, CPVC drain piping, GI ducting, grilles, diffusers, dampers, thermal and acoustic insulation, AHU control panel, power cables, GI cable trays, MS supporting structures and all required fittings, supports and accessories.

Design, installation, testing and commissioning of the complete DX air-conditioning system, including erection of condensing units and AHUs, laying of refrigerant and drain piping, ducting, insulation, electrical cables, control panels, cable trays, supporting structures, concrete foundations, core cutting and associated civil and electrical works, complete with refrigerant charging, air balancing, performance testing, submission of drawings and final handing over in satisfactory working condition.

Dismantling and removal of the existing HVAC units and associated equipment under buyback arrangement, including safe shifting and transportation from the site. The buyback value shall be quoted separately and deducted from the total estimate value.
